text: dsh-credential-retirement-proof 是一款 DSH 工具插件，向 DSH 注册凭据退役检查与验证工具。它读取调用方提供的凭据轮转清单，检查消费者回执、旧凭据拒绝、新凭据启用、重叠时长和零残留闭合等条件，并输出脱敏的判定结果。验证工具还会把报告按内容摘要命名写入工作区，随后读取文件核对摘要。适合需要离线整理轮转结算证据的 DSH 用户；本插件不执行轮转操作。运行需要 Node.js 22 或更高版本。

dsh-credential-retirement-proof adds DSH tools to inspect a supplied retirement manifest and verify its receipts, credential probes, overlap timing, and zero-residual closure. It writes a redacted report named by its content digest and checks the saved file. Requires Node.js 22 or newer.
想离线核对一份凭据轮转是否完成退役闭合。
帮我检查新旧凭据回执、重叠窗口和零残留条件是否都满足。
I need an offline verdict from a supplied credential retirement manifest.
功能「检查退役清单」：读取 JSON 清单并核对消费者覆盖、回执、凭据探测结果、时间窗口、观察者数量与闭合状态，返回结算判定及各项检查结果。通过 DSH 工具调用，输入清单 JSON。
功能「生成内容寻址报告」：验证工具接收工作区内的清单路径和报告目录，生成脱敏判定报告，以报告摘要作为文件名写入，并读取文件确认摘要一致。

dsh-credential-retirement-proof README · dsh-credential-retirement-proof：**Maintainer / Author：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen) · [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)**

Offline, deterministic evidence that a **supplied** credential rotation activated a new credential for every declared consumer, rejected the old credential, stayed inside its overlap window and reached a fresh zero-residual closure. Inputs and reports contain hashes and bounded public metadata only—never secrets.

dsh-credential-retirement-proof README · dsh-credential-retirement-proof：This is deliberately not another key rotator. Existing DSH plugins such as `dsh-key-rotation` and `dsh-llm-key-rotation` perform pool switching and failover. This plugin performs no issuance, distribution, switching, revocation, probing or live-system query. It only recomputes a redacted settlement verdict from explicit receipts.

```sh
npm test
npm run check
node bin/dsh-credential-retirement-proof.mjs verify examples/settled.json
```

dsh-credential-retirement-proof README · dsh-credential-retirement-proof：DSH tools: `dsh_credential_retirement_inspect` and `dsh_credential_retirement_verify`. MCP exposes equivalent proof-only inline tools. Reports explicitly retain `authenticatesReceipts: false`, `provesConsumerSetExhaustive: false`, and `provesAbsenceOfUndeclaredBindings: false`.

References: [NIST SP 800-57 Part 1 Rev. 5](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/57/pt1/r5/final) and [NIST SP 800-63B revocation/termination guidance](https://pages.nist.gov/800-63-3/sp800-63b.html#sec6).

MIT licensed.

dsh-credential-retirement-proof README · dsh-credential-retirement-proof：作者 / 维护者：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen)· [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)

离线、确定性的凭据退役证据层：只核验 supplied rotation manifest 是否在全部声明消费者上启用新凭据、拒绝旧凭据、满足重叠窗口，并形成新鲜的零残留闭合。输入和报告只有哈希与有界公开元数据，绝不包含秘密。

它不是第三个密钥轮转器。现有 `dsh-key-rotation`、`dsh-llm-key-rotation` 会做池切换和故障转移；本插件不签发、不分发、不切换、不撤销、不探测、不查询线上系统，只复算回执判决。

dsh-credential-retirement-proof README · dsh-credential-retirement-proof：DSH 工具为 `dsh_credential_retirement_inspect` 与 `dsh_credential_retirement_verify`，MCP 提供等价的只验证工具。报告明确保留 `authenticatesReceipts: false`、`provesConsumerSetExhaustive: false`、`provesAbsenceOfUndeclaredBindings: false`。
